description: SimToll: A Highway Toll, Lane Selection, and Traffic Modeling Dataset is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Amjed Al-Mousa, Rajaa Alqudah. This dataset contains traffic information of a toll highway; the highway consists of a toll lane, a carpool lane, and three regular lanes. The traffic information includes the number of vehicles on each lane type and the average speed on each lane, at ntervals of 6 minutes. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
